name: Green Candle
description: Close is above open on the latest selected-period candle.

name: Volume Surge
description: Volume is at least twice its 20-period average.

name: Bullish Trend Alignment
description: Price and moving averages are aligned upward.

name: Bearish Trend Alignment
description: Price and moving averages are aligned downward.

name: Bullish EMA 9/21 Crossover
description: EMA 9 crosses above EMA 21 on the latest completed candle.

name: Bearish EMA 9/21 Crossover
description: EMA 9 crosses below EMA 21 on the latest completed candle.

name: Price Above Key EMAs
description: Close is above EMA 9, 21, 50 and 200.

name: Price Above Key SMAs
description: Close is above SMA 9, 21, 50 and 200.

name: Price Above Key WMAs
description: Close is above WMA 9, 21, 50 and 200.

name: Bullish Momentum
description: Price rises at least 2% with above-average volume.

name: RSI Oversold
description: 14-period RSI is below 30.

name: RSI Overbought
description: 14-period RSI is above 70.

name: 20-Period High Breakout
description: Close exceeds the prior 20-period high.

name: 20-Period Low Breakdown
description: Close falls below the prior 20-period low.

name: Near 52-Period High
description: Close is within 5% of its 52-period high.

name: Near 52-Period Low
description: Close is within 5% of its 52-period low.

name: Doji
description: Body is no more than 10% of the candle range.

name: Bullish Engulfing
description: Latest bullish body engulfs the previous bearish body.

name: Bearish Engulfing
description: Latest bearish body engulfs the previous bullish body.

name: NR7
description: Latest candle has the narrowest range of seven sessions.

name: VCP Setup
description: Trend, three tightening contractions, dry volume and price within 8% of its pivot.

name: VCP Breakout
description: A valid contraction closes above its pivot with at least 1.5× average volume.

name: Morning Star
description: Three-period bullish reversal: strong bearish body, small middle body and bullish recovery above the first body midpoint.

name: Evening Star
description: Three-period bearish reversal: strong bullish body, small middle body and bearish close below the first body midpoint.

name: Three White Soldiers
description: Three consecutive strong bullish candles with rising closes and opens inside the prior bodies.

name: Three Black Crows
description: Three consecutive strong bearish candles with falling closes and opens inside the prior bodies.

name: Bullish FVG
description: The latest period low is above the high from two periods earlier, leaving a wick-to-wick imbalance.

name: Bearish FVG
description: The latest period high is below the low from two periods earlier, leaving a wick-to-wick imbalance.

name: Volume Increasing
description: Average volume of the latest five periods is at least 15% above the preceding five-period average.

name: Volume Decreasing
description: Average volume of the latest five periods is at least 15% below the preceding five-period average.

name: Volume Up, Price Down
description: Five-period price is falling while recent five-period average volume is increasing by at least 15%.

name: Volume Down, Price Up
description: Five-period price is rising while recent five-period average volume is decreasing by at least 15%.

name: Negative RSI Divergence
description: Price forms a higher confirmed swing high while RSI forms a lower high.

name: Positive RSI Divergence
description: Price forms a lower confirmed swing low while RSI forms a higher low.

name: Double Top
description: Two confirmed highs within 3%, a meaningful valley, and a close below the neckline.

name: Double Bottom
description: Two confirmed lows within 3%, a meaningful peak, and a close above the neckline.

name: RSI Double Top
description: Two RSI swing highs within five points followed by a break below the intervening RSI valley.

name: RSI Double Bottom
description: Two RSI swing lows within five points followed by a break above the intervening RSI peak.

name: All-Time High Breakout
description: Latest selected-timeframe candle closes above the highest price recorded before that period.

name: Bullish EMA Alignment + First Close Above 9
description: EMA 9 > 21 > 50 > 200 and price has just crossed from below to close above EMA 9.

name: Bullish SMA Alignment + First Close Above 9
description: SMA 9 > 21 > 50 > 200 and price has just crossed from below to close above SMA 9.

name: Bullish WMA Alignment + First Close Above 9
description: WMA 9 > 21 > 50 > 200 and price has just crossed from below to close above WMA 9.

name: Approaching ATH — First Visit
description: Price enters the zone within 3% below its prior all-time high for the first distinct visit in the latest 60 selected periods.

name: Approaching ATH — Second Visit
description: Price re-enters the zone within 3% below its prior all-time high after first moving outside it.

name: First Close Above ATH
description: Latest price closes above the all-time high that existed before this selected period for the first time.

name: Second Close Above ATH
description: Price records a second consecutive selected-period close above the ATH that existed before the first breakout close.

name: ATH Breakout Retest
description: After its first close above ATH, the latest selected-period candle returns within 2% of that breakout level and closes at or above it.
